mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHPF001 (PRFL_ID, CP_ID, CS_ID, EVSE_ID, STACK_LVL, PRPS, KIND, RCRNC_KIND, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, RC_ID, CS_STATUS, REG_DT, REG_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID) VALUES (#{p.profileId}, #{p.cpId}, #{p.csId}, #{p.evseId}, #{p.stackLevel}, #{p.purpose, typeHandler=kr.co.kevit.localcsms.common.util.typehandler.ChargingProfilePurposeHandler}, #{p.kind, typeHandler=kr.co.kevit.localcsms.common.util.typehandler.ChargingProfileKindHandler}, #{p.recurrencyKind}, #{p.validFrom}, #{p.validTo}, #{p.rechargingId}, #{p.csStatus}, NOW(), #{p.writer.regUserId}, NOW(), #{p.writer.updUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CHPF001 SET EVSE_ID = #{p.evseId}, STACK_LVL = #{p.stackLevel}, PRPS = #{p.purpose, typeHandler=kr.co.kevit.localcsms.common.util.typehandler.ChargingProfilePurposeHandler}, KIND = #{p.kind, typeHandler=kr.co.kevit.localcsms.common.util.typehandler.ChargingProfileKindHandler}, RCRNC_KIND = #{p.recurrencyKind}, VALID_FROM = #{p.validFrom}, VALID_TO = #{p.validTo}, RC_ID = #{p.rechargingId}, CS_STATUS = #{p.csStatus}, UPD_DT = NOW(), UPD_ID = #{p.writer.updUserId} WHERE PRFL_ID = #{p.profileId} AND CP_ID = #{p.cpId} AND CS_ID = #{p.csId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.PRFL_ID, p.CP_ID, p.CS_ID, p.EVSE_ID, p.STACK_LVL, p.PRPS, p.KIND, p.RCRNC_KIND, p.VALID_FROM, p.VALID_TO, p.RC_ID, p.CS_STATUS, p.REG_DT, p.REG_ID, p.UPD_DT, p.UPD_ID, s.SCHD_LIST_JSON FROM TB_CHPF001 p LEFT JOIN TB_CHPF002 s ON s.PRFL_ID = p.PRFL_ID WHERE p.PRFL_ID = #{profileId} AND p.CP_ID = #{cpId} AND p.CS_ID = #{csId} LIMIT 1
